_provenance.source: UniProt REST API (rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search, query 'gene:TTN AND organism_id:9606 AND reviewed:true'), live query during development
_provenance.note: Real UniProt Q8WZ42 (Titin) feature annotations, verbatim type/description/location. Titin's PEVK region is the field-standard example of a large, well-documented repeat region tolerating extensive in-frame length variation (including natural alternative splicing removing/adding whole PEVK repeat units) without a disease association -- see e.g. Herman et al. 2012 NEJM on TTN truncating variants in cardiomyopathy, and ClinGen's TTN-specific curation guidance on PEVK-region indel interpretation. Used here to ground PM4's repeat-region caveat test in a real, citable annotation; the specific test variant paired with it is constructed (see tests/test_pm4_ps4.py), since a ClinVar Benign/Likely benign record could not be confidently cross-referenced to these exact residue coordinates -- TTN has multiple clinically-used transcripts (e.g. the cardiac N2AB isoform, NM_001267550) with residue numbering that does not directly correspond to this canonical full-length (N2A, Q8WZ42) isoform's numbering, and no genomic-coordinate-based cross-check was performed for this fixture.
